notes.notes:

Fixed in-app purchases
New main menu

notes.title: The Cargo: Pre-release Week + Prize Draw
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/K2TSzYs.png?1[/img]
Pre-release Week has begun! Win your free “Leviathan: The Cargo” Steam key.

Hi, friends! We launch the SuperContest: repost - win "Leviathan: the Cargo"

REPOST THIS MESSAGE AND NEXT PRE-RELEASE POSTS AND GET A CHANCE TO WIN "LEVIATHAN: THE CARGO".

That's right. Every next repost on pre-release week takes part in the Prize Draw. That means that quantity of winners is equal to quantity of posts before release. Chances get up!
RULES
- Repost everything from our [url=https://www.facebook.com/leviathangame]Facebook Group[/url] during 7 days.
- Wait the results in the Day of the Release.

The more you repost, the more chances to win the key you have. But you can't win more than one key. We'll sum-up the draw on the pre-release twitch stream. Stay updated and don't miss it!

Follow the daily news on our website and social networks!

Good luck, friends! Let's go!

http://thelostwood.com/?page=week0701

notes.title: New Patch!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/VcQBOBS.png[/img]

Changelog:
- reduced game size
- improved video performance
- fixed transition between 4th and 5th episodes not working in English version
- fixed fisherman giving the player a book of aberrations
- fixed black screen after the dialogue with books when starting a new game from episode 2
- fixed achievement for finishing episode 2

notes.title: Релиз 5-го эпизода\ Release of episode 5
notes.notes:
[h1] Эпизод 5. Релиз.[/h1]

Друзья, мы всё улучшили!
[list]
 [*]переименовали Руф в Дарину в английской версии
 [*]убрали баг с неработающим телефоном
 [*]добавли 5-ый эпизод в русской версии
 [*]добавили 4-ый эпизод на английском и немецком в iOS
 [*]фастфорвард доступен всем
 [*]переделали полностью стим-ачивменты
 [*]исправили искажение "секретной фотографии"
 [*]улучшили анимации Дарины в детстве
 [*]убрали версионность игры[/list]
 [*] добавили MAC-версию

С любовью,
Lostwood.

[h1]Episode 5. Release.[/h1]

Fellows, we have improved everything!

 [*] renamed Ruth to Darina as she is called in Russian version
 [*] removed a bag with a broken phone
 [*] added episode 5 in Russian version
 [*] added episode 4 in English and German to the iOS version
 [*] fast forward is unlocked from the start
 [*] redone steam-achievements from scratch
 [*] fixed the low quality of "the secret photography"
 [*] improved Darina's animation in childhood
 [*] removed game revisions
 [*] added Mac-version

With love, 
Lostwood
